about_the_game:
A first-person narrative journey through memory and dream. Step into the mind of a photographer searching for his lost past, and discover what defines a life.

Beyond Memoria is a first-person narrative adventure that immerses you in a fragile world between dream and reality.
You play as a photographer trapped within his own mind, where memories fracture and emotions reshape the environment.

Every step brings you closer to hidden truths.
Every glance reveals fragments long forgotten.
Every photo becomes a way to restore what has been lost.

But memory is never faithful.
And sometimes, what we choose to remember matters as much as what we forget…

✦ What awaits you:

  • A short yet intense journey, blending contemplation and tension.

  • A dreamlike universe where landscapes mirror the protagonist’s inner world.

  • Photography and exploration mechanics to restore broken fragments of memory.

  • An intimate story about memory, identity, and the bonds that define us.

Memento ergo sum — I remember, therefore I am.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10+ (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460, 2.70GHz or AMD FX™-6300 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: no
  • VR Support: no

short_description: Beyond Memoria is a first-person narrative journey between dream and memory. Explore a surreal world and use photography to uncover forgotten fragments and piece together your story.
supported_languages:
English*, French
*languages with full audio support
